en.subtitle: Full-stack development & AI agents
en.intro: I work on web and mobile apps, backend services, and tools for AI agents.
en.experienceCopy: I've worked on Flutter and Vue applications, enterprise management and auction systems, and healthcare IoT integrations for hospitals.

projects.name: Webhook Delivery Platform
projects.description: Sends events to HTTP endpoints and retries failed requests. The web console lets you manage endpoints, inspect each delivery attempt, and replay jobs.
details: Java, Spring Boot, PostgreSQL, and React
At-least-once: receivers need to handle duplicate events
Docker Compose includes a receiver that simulates failures

projects.name: MCP Trace Lab
projects.description: Records traffic between an MCP client and a stdio server. Use the command-line summary to check which tools were called, what failed, and how long responses took.
details: Local JSONL traces with text or JSON summaries
stdio only; sensitive fields can be redacted by key name

projects.name: ADB Device Desk
projects.description: Connect Android devices from a Windows desktop app, diagnose ADB issues, and export screenshots or logs.
details: Windows build passed; physical-device acceptance pending

projects.name: Mutual Chat
projects.description: Encrypted Matrix messaging as a standalone app or an embeddable panel, with session recovery and local message search.
details: Web app, embeddable panel and Windows desktop preview
Encrypted messaging tested; device verification and mobile acceptance pending

projects.name: Mutual Transfer
projects.description: Move files through a shared LAN workspace, resume interrupted uploads, check file hashes, and manage paired devices.
details: Node.js and a responsive browser client
Server-mediated; all workspace members can read and delete files
Large-file and recovery tests passed; physical LAN acceptance pending

projects.name: Personal website template
projects.description: Use this site as a starting point for your own page. The guide covers copying the repository, editing your profile, and publishing with GitHub Pages.
details: Name, introduction, experience and projects in one JSON file
English and Chinese, light and dark themes, mobile layout

zh.role: 软件开发工程师 · 6 年开发经验

zh.experienceCopy: 做过 Flutter 和 Vue 应用、企业管理与拍卖系统，以及医院设备相关的软件集成。

projects.name: 可靠 Webhook 推送平台
projects.description: 将事件推送到 HTTP 接口，失败后自动重试。可以在网页控制台管理接收地址、查看每次请求的结果，并手动重新推送。
details: 至少一次投递，接收方需要处理重复事件
Docker Compose 附带可模拟请求失败的接收服务

projects.name: MCP Trace Lab
projects.description: 记录 MCP 客户端与 stdio 服务端之间的通信。通过命令行查看调用了哪些工具、哪些请求出错，以及响应花了多长时间。
details: 本地 JSONL 记录，以及文本或 JSON 格式的分析摘要
目前仅支持 stdio，可按字段名配置脱敏

projects.name: ADB Device Desk
projects.description: 在 Windows 桌面应用中连接安卓设备、排查 ADB 问题，并保存截图或日志。
details: Windows 构建已通过，真机验收待完成

projects.name: Mutual Chat
projects.description: 基于 Matrix 的加密聊天，可独立运行，也可嵌入其他应用，支持会话恢复和本地消息搜索。
details: 网页应用、嵌入式面板和 Windows 桌面预览版
加密通信已测试，设备验证和移动端验收待完成

projects.name: Mutual Transfer
projects.description: 通过局域网共享空间传文件，支持断点续传、文件校验和配对设备管理。
details: 由服务端中转，空间成员都可读取和删除文件
大文件和恢复测试已通过，局域网真机验收待完成
